meta.synthetic_data_note: All trades are synthetic and prices are illustrative. Equity tickers and identifiers aim to match real listed securities but are not reference data. LEIs and bond, FX and swap identifiers are made up. All identifiers pass their check-digit rules.

principal.Forward: base notional * rate, in the quote currency
principal.Swap: notional * fixed rate / 100 / 2 (first semi-annual fixed amount)

economic_conventions.net_settlement: principal + accrued + fees when we pay (BUY, PAY_FIXED); principal + accrued - fees when we receive (SELL, REC_FIXED). Cash amounts are unsigned on both tabs.
economic_conventions.accrued_interest: Bonds only. US Treasuries Actual/Actual, corporates 30/360, to the settlement date.
economic_conventions.commission: Tab 2 has no commission column, so fees show only in Net_Cash_Amount.
economic_conventions.settlement: Equities and bonds T+1. FX forwards on the value date. Swaps effective T+2.
economic_conventions.allocations: Allocated principal is exact. Accrued and fees are pro rata, with the last allocation carrying any rounding, so quantity and net cash sum exactly to the block.

multi_leg_rules.FX_SWAP_NET: LEG_1_PAY buys base on the near date; LEG_2_RECEIVE sells it on the far date. Street row: notional = leg notional, Exec_Price_Rate = far rate - near rate, Net_Cash_Amount = |far amount - near amount|, Value_Settle_Date = far date, direction = PAY if the near amount is larger, otherwise REC.
multi_leg_rules.FIXED_FIXED_NET: LEG_1_PAY pays one fixed rate; LEG_2_RECEIVE receives another. Street row: notional = leg notional, Exec_Price_Rate and Coupon = |rate difference|, Net_Cash_Amount = |leg 1 net - leg 2 net|, direction = PAY if leg 1 net is larger, otherwise REC. Fixed/fixed is used because the Side column has no floating-rate value.

normalization_reference.blank_direction_rule: When Dir_Ind is blank, a negative quantity means SELL or PAY and a positive quantity means BUY or REC. Swap products and FX_SWAP net rows use PAY and REC.
normalization_reference.dealer_view_rule: DEALER_BILATERAL_VIEW rows state the dealer's side, so invert direction to get our side. PB_CLIENT_VIEW rows already state our side.

price_quote_conventions.DECIMAL_CLEAN_PCT: Decimal clean price, percent of par.
price_quote_conventions.32NDS_UST: WHOLE-TT or WHOLE-TT+ where TT is 32nds and + adds 1/64. 98-24 = 98.75; 98-11+ = 98.359375.
price_quote_conventions.DIRTY_PCT: Dirty price. Clean = dirty - Reported_Accrued_Int / abs(quantity) * 100; round to 6 decimals.
price_quote_conventions.NET_FIXED_SPREAD_PCT: Absolute difference between the two fixed rates, percent.

normalization_reference.security_lookup: Primary_Security_ID resolves against the Tab 1 column named by Security_ID_Source. FX and swap rows have no CUSIP or SEDOL, so those brokers fall back to ISIN.

tolerances.accrued_interest_note: Net_Cash_Amount moves by the same amount as accrued.
tolerances.fx_rate_note: Net_Cash_Amount moves by notional * rate difference and should not break on its own.
